_note: direct: feeds proven working in the sibling Welcome to Your Galaxy repos.
Nothing invented — an untested feed URL reports itself unreachable on every
harvest and quietly makes the coverage figure a lie.
gnews: Google News locale searches; the harvester builds the URL from
hl / gl / ceid. Twenty-four queries rotate across 46 locales.
events: subject searches for observer missions, rulings, enforcement and the
official  electoral commissions, courts, prosecutors, observer missions
research  election monitoring, integrity indices, money-in-politics research
press     general news across the locales
rights    transparency and voting rights organisations
Worth adding, with URLs you have opened: International IDEA, the Electoral
Integrity Project, OSCE/ODIHR, the Carter Center, NDI, IFES, ACE Project,
OpenSecrets, ACLED and the Brennan Center.
